items.title: What Can Make Fair Isaac Stock A Buy?
items.summary: The part of Fair Isaac that could change the case for its stock is software, not the credit score. Banks use this software to decide on loans, catch fraud and collect debts. You may still think of Fair Isaac only as the company behind the FICO score that mortgage lenders check.
